full_judgment: Md. Abdur Rouf J: House No. 39, Sher Shah Shuri Road, Block-D, Mohammadpur, Dhaka, having been enlisted in the "Ka" list of the abandoned buildings, the petitioner instituted Case No. 459 of 1989 under section 7(1) of Ordinance No. 54 of 1985 in the First Court of Settlement, Dhaka, claiming release of the said house from the list of abandoned property. Her case, in short, is that the property in question originally belonged to one PC Hashem and after Hashem's death his heirs on 10-8-77 entered into an agreement with her to sell the property and in pursuance thereof she got the kabala registered on 19-10-78. Since then she has been possessing the house on payment of rents, taxes after getting her name mutated in the relevant khatian. But the concerned authority with some malafide intention wrongly listed the house as abandoned property.
